messages.subject: Plotting problems with ggplot and htmlwidgets
parts:
Hi,

I've made this fairly complicated shiny app:
http://ec2-23-22-236-244.compute-1.amazonaws.com:3838/nba-2014/

My problem is fairly trivial and can be solved by refreshing the page, but I'm curious.

On the 'models' tab, the three logit curves work great the first time, but when you navigate to a different 'page' and come back they are not lined up anymore. Two appear below the first. Adjusting the slider moves them back into place. This is an HTMLwidget wrapper for my javascript D3 library (http://benjh33.github.io/ggd3/) and I'm no pro at javascript, but I don't see why my code would cause this behavior.

Secondly, the 'predict' page has a tabsetPanel with four tabs. The three inner tabs have a simple roc plot, made with pROC. Again, the first time going to the page it works fine. Leaving the page and coming back results in the charts not appearing. 

Curious if anyone has any explanation about why I'm seeing this behavior.

Thanks,
Ben
